intro: Guard Berton is a human town guardsman stationed outside the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains. Frustrated by the bureaucratic delays of Stormwind's legal system, he seeks swift justice against Targorr the Dread, an imprisoned orc leader.

p: While Redridge Mountains buckles under the threat of the Blackrock orc invasion, Guard Berton remains posted outside the Lakeshire Inn. Despite local defenses being pushed to the brink, Berton's attention is fixed on a captive enemy: Targorr the Dread. Targorr was captured and locked away deep within the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to death for his crimes against the kingdom. Yet with Stormwind's execution postponed indefinitely, Berton refuses to let the brutal raider linger in a cell while Lakeshire bleeds. Taking matters into his own hands, he hires willing adventurers to bypass royal delays and execute the orc directly.
